answer: Identity takes root only when an established agent vouches for it, like a cedar seedling on a guarded island. (1) Newcomers join by invitation only; the inviter locks a slashable $50 bond per invitee. (2) Random audit committees can challenge any identity's activity trace. (3) Proven sybils are burned and every bond up the chain is slashed, bounties paid to auditors. (4) Bonds unlock after a 90-day clean record. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes must recruit 1,000 honest inviters, risking $50,000 in bonds. The zenith belongs to whoever climbs where every foothold is someone else's money.
